_doc: workshop v1.2: recipes, upgrades, salvage yields keyed by frozen LOOT_NAMES; numbers only. out = ITEM_DEFS type (or a GEAR_PACKS id); qty = pool units (masterkey units = charges). Tier II needs the bench_tools upgrade. No XP for crafting.

recipes.name: Batteries ×2
recipes.desc: LMB swaps in a fresh cell: your flashlight is back to 100%.

recipes.name: Lockpick set (3)
recipes.desc: Hold E on a locked door without the card. Slow and loud, but it opens.

recipes.name: Overshoes
recipes.desc: Rubberised soft soles: quieter footsteps. Worn out at the end of the contract.

recipes.name: Glowsticks ×5
recipes.desc: Drop to mark a path. Keeps a Mannequin lit.

recipes.name: Flares ×3
recipes.desc: LMB to throw. Burns red for 60 s and keeps the room lit.

recipes.name: Medkit
recipes.desc: Revive a teammate where they fell, within 30 s. Single use.

recipes.name: Motion sensors ×2
recipes.desc: LMB to place. The van console shows anything that moves within 6 m.

recipes.name: Crowbar
recipes.desc: LMB to swing. Frees a grabbed teammate. Loud.

recipes.name: Walkie-talkie
recipes.desc: Hold Q to transmit. Everyone holding one hears you.

recipes.name: Pro Flashlight
recipes.desc: LED beam from any slot: brighter, wider, twice the battery.

recipes.name: Noise lures ×2
recipes.desc: LMB to throw: it rattles where it lands, away from you.

recipes.name: Master keycard (3)
recipes.desc: Three charges. A locked door opens at once; a security door opens quietly.

recipes.name: NV module
recipes.desc: Night vision from any slot (N). Drains the battery twice as fast, and never counts as light.

recipes.name: Adrenaline syringe
recipes.desc: LMB inject: 15 s of sprint without getting tired.

recipes.name: Lucky charm
recipes.desc: Carry it to the van: your deposits count +10%.

recipes.name: Flashbulbs (3)
recipes.desc: LMB: a blinding 2 s flash that counts as light. Loud pop.

recipes.name: Field receiver (5)
recipes.desc: Tunes in to the site around you. Five listens.

upgrades.name: Soldering station
upgrades.desc: A proper iron and a vise. Unlocks the tier II recipes.

upgrades.name: Charging rack
upgrades.desc: Flashlights recharge in the van in 8 s instead of 25 and hold 30% more charge.

upgrades.name: Roof scanner
upgrades.desc: The van console reads motion sensors at 12 m and shows anything moving within 8 m of a living crewmate.

upgrades.name: Stretcher
upgrades.desc: A filed badge brings the crewmate back in 8 s instead of 20, at 75 hp.
